children.text: Learn how to navigate your dashboard, pick a theme, set up payments, and more — in less than 20 minutes.
Master your BigCommerce control panel, set up the basics, launch a flashy homepage, and bring your store to life.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce platform overview tutorial cover displaying core ecommerce features and presenter.

children.text: How to navigate the control panel

Just getting started with BigCommerce? This quick control panel tour shows where orders, products, customers, and storefront settings live, plus the Launch checklist for store setup and the Dashboard for tracking sales, orders, and visitor activity.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce Essentials video thumbnail featuring a presenter next to an e-commerce platform setup checklist graphic.

children.text: Cover your BigCommerce store’s essentials: entering your business name and contact info in Store Profile, picking a default currency, and setting localization options like measurement units, time zone, date format, and storefront languages.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing initial store configuration steps and video presenter.

children.text: Start styling your BigCommerce storefront. Browse and preview themes, upload your logo, and adjust colors and fonts with Theme Styles in Page Builder, then check out the refreshed storefront at the end.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce store launch tutorial cover highlighting essential readiness checks and video presenter.

children.text: How to Build Your BigCommerce Homepage

Create a BigCommerce homepage in Page Builder with a Hero Banner and a Product Set that spotlights products. Then rearrange sections, tweak the built-in carousel, and choose which pages and categories appear in your navigation.
Build your catalog in no time with single and bulk product additions, pricing options, variants, and more.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing online store platform architecture and video presenter.

children.text: Add and Organize Product Categories In Your BigCommerce Store

Group products into browsable categories for shoppers. In this BigCommerce walkthrough, you’ll create a category, add a description and image, set its visibility, nest a subcategory under a parent, and see the result in storefront navigation.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce store setup tutorial cover displaying core platform features and video presenter.

children.text: How to Add a Single Product to Your BigCommerce Store

Ready to list your first BigCommerce product? This quick walkthrough covers entering a name, price, and weight, assigning a category, adding a description and images, then saving it and finding it on your storefront.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing store integration options and video presenter.

children.text: BigCommerce Setting Pricing, Variants, and Product Options

Configure pricing and product choices in BigCommerce. Learn where to set a product’s price, cost, MSRP, and sale price; create variants like colors; manage inventory, SKUs, and pricing per variant; and add customization options like a text field or pick list.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing store marketing tools and video presenter.

children.text: How to Bulk Add or Edit Products In Your BigCommerce Store

Need to add or update many products at once? Learn how BigCommerce’s Import/Export tools handle a CSV file: export the Bulk Edit template, edit the product data, import it, confirm fields are mapped correctly, and review the results.
Set up payment processing (sans transaction fees), configure shipping zones and rates, and connect your domain without costly developer involvement.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing platform navigation settings and video presenter.

children.text: Start accepting payments in your BigCommerce store. This video covers turning on BigCommerce Payments, picking a setup path, submitting business details for verification, and confirming your payment method is active, plus where to find other payment gateway options.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing store product listing tools and video presenter.

children.text: Configuring Shipping Zones and Rates In Your BigCommerce Store

Decide where you ship and what customers pay for delivery. Learn about shipping origin, zones, and rate types (flat-rate, free, and real-time carrier rates) in BigCommerce, then create a regional zone and preview shipping options at checkout.

imageAlt.value: Basics of BigCommerce tutorial thumbnail showing store order fulfillment screen and presenter.

children.text: Connecting a Domain Name with BigCommerce

Point a custom domain at your BigCommerce store. See where to buy a domain or link one you own, which DNS records to update with your provider, and how to make a verified domain your primary storefront address.
For detailed instructions on connecting an existing domain, visit the BigCommerce guide to changing domains:
Go big with promotion and discount codes, a primer on sales and marketing channels, campaign building basics, and analytics.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce platform introduction video cover highlighting core features, control panel, and host presenter.

children.text: How to Create a Promotion or Discount Code

Drive sales with promotions, storewide discounts, product-specific reductions, and coupon codes. You can even set minimum purchasing thresholds to trigger specific promotions or discounts, rewarding your most loyal customers.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce online store builder tutorial cover highlighting layout configuration tools and presenter.

children.text: Expand your reach with ease using the Channel Manager. Learn how to view and connect channels like Facebook and Instagram Shopping, Amazon, eBay, and more, all synced with your BigCommerce catalog.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce ecommerce platform tutorial cover displaying analytics, navigation controls, and video presenter.

children.text: Refine and center your efforts around a primary goal with campaign management tools. Create a promotion or coupon code, turn on Abandoned Cart emails, add a homepage banner, and more.

imageAlt.value: BigCommerce platform overview video thumbnail displaying store management controls and analytics graphics.

children.text: Make sure your efforts are worth it with in-depth tracking via the Analytics Dashboard. Learn how to track sales, orders, site visitors, and more. From there, zero in on conversion rates, top performing products or pages, and beyond, with breakdowns by traffic source and channels.
Ready to put these steps into action?
Build your store as you watch, or dive into a free trial to explore BigCommerce risk-free for 15 days.

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
